DDInter803.mechanism: The concomitant use of certain medications (e.g., cytarabine, fluorouracil, methotrexate, and iron) may cause displacement of gallium citrate Ga-67 from plasma protein binding sites and interfere with test results.

DDInter962.mechanism: INTERVAL: Renal toxicity has been reported in a few patients with liver dysfunction who were given an oral cholecystographic agent followed by intravenous contrast agents. The mechanism of interaction has not been described.
